briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.0 escalate frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intense compute competition. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction for multi-agent security.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced reasoning. Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Opus. Meta's Llama 4 open weights spark developer adoption. DeepSeek-V4 narrows gap on coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across automotive, IoT, and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units shipped. Microsoft expands Stargate to 100k H100 clusters. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving 15% month-over-month.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU slow frontier scaling before 2027 or merely shift it to allied nations?
